mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% compresses equity discount rates through reduced risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without threshold requirements.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.2% in a 3-month window signals labor market deterioration that reduces corporate profit visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.2% (3mo), or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate collapsing consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in >55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% y/y) forces monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (y/y) periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Consistent payroll growth (PAYEMS > 0.5% monthly) sustains consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of PAYEMS > 0.5% (monthly) periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 2000.0 thousand units signal sector contraction that reduces economic activity and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of HOUST < 2000.0 instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) and elevated federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) indicate dual economic stress, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint UNRATE > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0% fails to predict negative returns in >55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong economic expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% annualized) boosts corporate earnings visibility, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of GDPC1 growth > 2.5% (annualized) periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
